description: MALAI: Get what the user has eaten today against their MALAI targets: calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber eaten vs target, what is left (especially protein), and how many entries are logged. Use for "how am I doing today", "how much protein do I have left", "am I on track", or before suggesting what to eat. These are the user's real logged numbers; do not estimate them.
name: malai_get_today_nutrition

entries.description: Number of food log entries today.

isPlaceholderProfile.description: True if the profile was never filled in; targets are then not personal.

remaining.description: Target minus eaten; null without targets.

targets.description: Null when the user has no targets yet.

title: Today's nutrition
